title: 30 Years of Pony: Ginuwine and Ro James Brought R&B Home to the Bronx
caption_instagram:
30 years of Pony and the Bronx showed up 🐎 Swipe for the night →

Ginuwine with special guest Ro James, one night only at @lehmancenter, the largest venue in the Bronx. Our co-founder Wally (@wstudiosnj) was on the scene for his first concert ever, and as 80s babies who grew up on this era of R&B, this one hit home.

Thank you to Leah Grammatica, Alexa Downing and the whole Lehman Center team for having the Den. @ginuwine, thank you for the night.

What's your #1 Ginuwine song? 👇 Send this to the friend you would have taken.

caption_linkedin:
Thirty years after his debut single, Ginuwine still filled the largest venue in the Bronx.

On Saturday, The Innovators Den covered Ginuwine with special guest Ro James at Lehman Center for the Performing Arts. Three things stood out:

1. Legacy compounds. A song released in 1996 still brought out every age group, dressed up and singing along.
2. Local rooms matter. Lehman Center gives the Bronx major shows without crossing a bridge.
3. Firsts still happen. It was our co-founder Osvaldo "Wally" Rodriguez's first concert ever.

Thank you to Leah Grammatica, Alexa Downing and the Lehman Center team.

cta_line: R&B never left. *The Bronx proved it.*

slides.label: The night
slides.text: Saturday, *Nov. 7*. *Ginuwine* with special guest *Ro James* at *Lehman Center for the Performing Arts*, the largest venue in the Bronx, on the Lehman College campus.

slides.label: The room
slides.text: A line through the lobby, full fits, security at the rope and phones up before the lights went down. The Bronx came *dressed*.

slides.label: The legend
slides.text: *Pony* was Ginuwine's debut single in *1996*, produced by *Timbaland*, and it hit *No. 6* on the Hot 100. Thirty years later he's *56* and still working the edge of the stage.

slides.label: 80s babies
slides.text: We're *80s babies*. We were kids when this R&B era arrived, and we grew up on every song of it. Hearing it live in the Bronx took us *right back*.

slides.label: First concert
slides.text: Our co-founder *Wally* (Osvaldo Rodriguez) was on the scene for the Den. It was his *first concert ever*. Ginuwine in the Bronx is a hard one to top.

slides.label: The crowd
slides.text: Every age in the room singing along, phones in the air all night. That's what *R&B* still does: it brings people *together*.

slides.label: Thank you
slides.text: Thank you to *Leah Grammatica*, *Alexa Downing* and the whole *Lehman Center* team for having the Den. The Bronx is lucky to have you.

slides.label: The Den's take
slides.text: R&B never left. It just needed a room like this. More nights like this, *Lehman*. We'll be back.
